source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of debugging techniques (PDF 63-64).

items: Print statements: code ke mukhtalif marahil par print laga kar variables ki values dekhna.
Debugging tools: pdb (Python Debugger) jaise tools se code qadam ba qadam chalana, variables dekhna aur program ka bahao samajhna.
Error messages: ghalti ke paighaam parh kar samajhna ke masla kahan hai.

blocks.text: Misaal: divide function ko sifar nasab (denominator) ke saath bulaya jata hai, jis se ZeroDivisionError aata hai. try-except block ghalti pakar kar paighaam print karta hai, jis se masla pehchanne aur sambhalne mein madad milti hai.

Wazahat: divide do adad taqseem karta hai. 10 ko 0 se taqseem karne par ZeroDivisionError aata hai; except usay e naam se pakar kar Python ka apna paighaam ("division by zero") ke saath print karta hai.

blocks.prompt: Yeh program kya paigham print karta hai?

items: Debugging ke tareeqe: print, pdb, error messages.
except ... as e: ghalti ka paighaam e mein.
